name: HV and LV cables with cable trays and accessories
description: HV and LV cables with cable trays and accessories for the 7-unit gas-engine generator plant and SESB 132/33/11 kV connection. Procurement / Electrical. BOQ quantities and dimensions are design inputs, not sourced facts.
aliases: HV and LV cables with cable trays and accessories

specifications.metric: Prysmian 132 kV XLP 800 mm2 Cu LS0H SC — maximum phase-to-phase voltage Um
specifications.basis: Prysmian datasheet '132 kV XLP 800 mm2 Cu LS0H SC IEC 60840', code E230FK90800MIDNE, Version: 18-ene-22 (18 January 2022): 'Tension maxima entre fases, Um: 145 kV'.

specifications.metric: Prysmian 132 kV XLP 800 mm2 Cu LS0H SC — lightning impulse withstand Up
specifications.basis: Prysmian datasheet code E230FK90800MIDNE, Version 18-ene-22: 'Tension a impulsos, Up: 650 kV'.

specifications.metric: Prysmian 132 kV XLP 800 mm2 Cu LS0H SC — nominal conductor cross-section
specifications.basis: Prysmian datasheet code E230FK90800MIDNE, Version 18-ene-22: 'Seccion transversal nominal: 800 mm2'.

specifications.metric: Prysmian 132 kV XLP 800 mm2 Cu LS0H SC — maximum conductor short-circuit current, 1 s
specifications.basis: Prysmian datasheet code E230FK90800MIDNE, Version 18-ene-22: 'Intensidad maxima de cortocircuito en el conductor durante 1 s: 114 kA'.

specifications.metric: Prysmian 132 kV XLP 800 mm2 Cu LS0H SC — maximum screen short-circuit current, 1 s
specifications.basis: Prysmian datasheet code E230FK90800MIDNE, Version 18-ene-22: 'Intensidad maxima de cortocircuito en la pantalla (Hilos de Cu + foil de aluminio) durante 1 s: 10 kA'.

specifications.metric: Prysmian 132 kV XLP 800 mm2 Cu LS0H SC — maximum conductor temperature in continuous service

specifications.metric: Prysmian 132 kV XLP 800 mm2 Cu LS0H SC — maximum conductor temperature during short circuit
specifications.basis: Prysmian datasheet code E230FK90800MIDNE, Version 18-ene-22: 'Temperatura maxima admisible en el conductor en regimen de cortocircuito: 250°C'.

specifications.metric: Prysmian 132 kV XLP 800 mm2 Cu LS0H SC — conductor DC resistance at 20 deg C
specifications.basis: Prysmian datasheet code E230FK90800MIDNE, Version 18-ene-22: 'Resistencia electrica del conductor a 20°C c.c.: 0.0221 Ohm/km'.

specifications.metric: Prysmian 132 kV XLP 800 mm2 Cu LS0H SC — capacitance
specifications.basis: Prysmian datasheet code E230FK90800MIDNE, Version 18-ene-22: 'Capacidad nominal: 0.2017 microF/km'.

specifications.basis: Powerandcables.com Nexans 33kV 1C 630sqmm BS7870 table: '1 Second Short Circuit Rating of a 35sqmm Copper wire screen (80 to 250°C) kA 4.8' (both conductor versions).

specifications.metric: Nexans 33 kV single-core 630 mm2 XLPE  — current carrying capacity, copper, laid in trefoil, in air
specifications.basis: Powerandcables.com Nexans 33kV 1C 630sqmm BS7870 table: 'Current Carrying Capacity (cables laid in trefoil) In Air A' copper 1160, aluminium 940. Ampacity basis printed on page: depth of cover 800 mm, soil thermal resistivity 1.2 K.m/W, soil temperature 15 deg C, ambient air 25 deg C, max conductor temperature 90 deg C.
